post.description:
Runs the agent and streams its progress as server-sent events.

Each frame is `event: <name>` and `data: <json>` followed by a blank line, flushed as soon as it is
produced. The response schema describes one decoded frame: `event` is the frame name and `data` is
its JSON payload.

| event | data | when |
|---|---|---|
| `conversation` | `ConversationEventData` | first frame, always |
| `quota` | `Usage` | right after the chat is counted |
| `stage` | `ToolCallStage` or `ToolResultStage` | each agent step |
| `result` | `PredictResponse` | once, at the end |
| `error` | `StreamErrorData` | instead of `result` when the run fails after the stream started |

Needs a session. Each call spends one chat from the daily quota; a call over the limit is a 402
before any frame. A run that fails before its first model response gives the chat back. Send
`conversation_id` to continue a saved conversation; the server builds the history from it.

Failures before the first frame are plain JSON errors with the statuses listed below.

rps.description: Ranked probability score, lower is better.

hit_rate.description: Share of fixtures whose top pick won, in [0, 1]; null if not recorded.

outcome.description:
The outcome the news moved the most.

* `H` - H
* `D` - D
* `A` - A

agent.description: Probability of that outcome after the news.

n_logged.description: Chats that brought news before kickoff.

n_compared.description: Logged chats with an opening and closing line.

rate.description: Share ahead of the market; null until enough chats are compared.

timezone_source.description:
`manual` pins the zone so later browser reports are ignored; defaults to `browser`.

* `browser` - browser
* `manual` - manual

PredictResponse.description: The agent's answer: baseline vs. adjusted, the adjustments, the words.

QuotaExceededError.description: The 402 body: the usual error plus where the user stands and where to upgrade.

StreamErrorData.description: Sent in place of `result` when the run fails after the stream has started.

status.description: The Stripe subscription status, passed through.

code.description: Three-letter club code; keys the crest set.

name.description: One of KNOWN_TOOL_NAMES today; treat others as opaque.

calibration.description: Live predictions, home/draw/away pooled into probability bins.

news_edge.description: Chats that brought news before kickoff, checked against the market's moves.

bookmaker.description: Bookmaker closing odds over the fixtures that have them.

calibration_error.description: Expected calibration error of the model; backtest only.

forecasters.description: Every forecaster scored in the backtest; empty for the live record.
